arrears_waive_reason.name: arrears_waive_reason
arrears_waive_reason.value: "arrears"."status" <> 'waived' OR ("arrears"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND length("arrears"."reason") > 0)

audit_log_mode.name: audit_log_mode
audit_log_mode.value: mode IS NULL OR mode IN ('test', 'live')

audit_log_money_reason.name: audit_log_money_reason
audit_log_money_reason.value: "audit_log"."amount_cents" IS NULL OR ("audit_log"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND length("audit_log"."reason") > 0)

coupons_value_matches_type.name: coupons_value_matches_type
coupons_value_matches_type.value:
("coupons"."discount_type" = 'percent' AND "coupons"."value_percent" BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND "coupons"."value_cents" IS NULL)
       OR ("coupons"."discount_type" = 'fixed' AND "coupons"."value_cents" > 0 AND "coupons"."value_percent" IS NULL)

payments_stripe_links.name: payments_stripe_links
payments_stripe_links.value:
("payments"."hosted_invoice_url" IS NULL OR "payments"."hosted_invoice_url" ~ '^https://([a-z0-9-]+\.)*stripe\.com/')
       AND ("payments"."invoice_pdf" IS NULL OR "payments"."invoice_pdf" ~ '^https://([a-z0-9-]+\.)*stripe\.com/')

registrations_quran_level.name: registrations_quran_level
registrations_quran_level.value: quran_level IS NULL OR quran_level IN ('no_letters', 'qaidah', 'quran', 'memorizing', 'beginner', 'intermediate', 'advanced')

registrations_teacher_pref.name: registrations_teacher_pref
registrations_teacher_pref.value: teacher_pref IS NULL OR teacher_pref IN ('male', 'female', 'no_preference')

registrations_session_minutes.name: registrations_session_minutes
registrations_session_minutes.value: session_minutes IS NULL OR session_minutes IN (30, 40, 45, 50, 60)

registrations_window.name: registrations_window
registrations_window.value: "registrations"."time_start" IS NULL OR "registrations"."time_end" IS NULL OR "registrations"."time_end" > "registrations"."time_start"

registrations_aid_level.name: registrations_aid_level
registrations_aid_level.value: aid_level IS NULL OR aid_level IN ('30', '45', '50', 'full')

registrations_agreed_fund.name: registrations_agreed_fund
registrations_agreed_fund.value: agreed_fee_fund IS NULL OR agreed_fee_fund IN ('zakat', 'special')

registrations_whatsapp_group.name: registrations_whatsapp_group
registrations_whatsapp_group.value: whatsapp_group IS NULL OR whatsapp_group IN ('yes', 'no', 'maybe')

registrations_stripe_mode.name: registrations_stripe_mode
registrations_stripe_mode.value: stripe_mode IS NULL OR stripe_mode IN ('test', 'live')

registrations_admission_fee.name: registrations_admission_fee
registrations_admission_fee.value: admission_fee IS NULL OR admission_fee IN ('standard', 'supported', 'complimentary', 'flexible', 'free', '50', '30')

registrations_money.name: registrations_money
registrations_money.value:
"registrations"."discount_cents" >= 0 AND "registrations"."refunded_cents" >= 0
       AND ("registrations"."per_class_cents" IS NULL OR "registrations"."per_class_cents" >= 0)
       AND ("registrations"."calculated_cents" IS NULL OR "registrations"."calculated_cents" >= 0)
       AND ("registrations"."payment_cents" IS NULL OR "registrations"."payment_cents" >= 0)
       AND ("registrations"."agreed_fee_cents" IS NULL OR "registrations"."agreed_fee_cents" >= 0)

registrations_country_codes.name: registrations_country_codes
registrations_country_codes.value:
("registrations"."country_res_code" IS NULL OR "registrations"."country_res_code" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$')
       AND ("registrations"."country_origin_code" IS NULL OR "registrations"."country_origin_code" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$')
       AND ("registrations"."country_ip" IS NULL OR "registrations"."country_ip" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$')

registrations_e164.name: registrations_e164
registrations_e164.value:
("registrations"."whatsapp_e164" IS NULL OR "registrations"."whatsapp_e164" ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$')
       AND ("registrations"."guardian_contact_e164" IS NULL OR "registrations"."guardian_contact_e164" ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$')
       AND ("registrations"."guardian_whatsapp_e164" IS NULL OR "registrations"."guardian_whatsapp_e164" ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$')

review_reasons_resolved_by.name: review_reasons_resolved_by
review_reasons_resolved_by.value: "review_reasons"."resolved_at" IS NULL OR "review_reasons"."resolved_by" IS NOT NULL
